TABLETALK.Title: Table Talk
TABLETALK.HoldToTalk: Hold {key} to talk to the GM
TABLETALK.Listening: Listening… let go when you're done
TABLETALK.Queued: Waiting for the GM to send: "{text}"
TABLETALK.NothingHeard: Didn't catch anything. Hold {key} a moment before you start talking.
TABLETALK.NoGM: No GM is connected, so nothing was saved.
TABLETALK.Waiting: {count} waiting for the GM to send
TABLETALK.SentToGM: The GM sent the table's turn.
TABLETALK.Insecure: Voice needs a secure page (https or localhost). Ask your GM to open Foundry over https.
TABLETALK.MicBlocked: Your browser blocked the microphone. Allow it for this page (the icon in the address bar), then try again.
TABLETALK.NoEngine: This browser can't turn speech into text. Try Chrome or Edge.
TABLETALK.SwitchingEngine: Your browser's speech service isn't available here; switching to the built-in model.
TABLETALK.ModelLoading: Getting the speech model ready (one-time download, {pct}%)…
TABLETALK.QueueEmpty: Nothing yet. Lines appear here as players talk.
TABLETALK.NotLinked: Claude Code isn't listening at {url}. Start it with Table Talk (see the module's readme).
TABLETALK.Refused: Claude Code refused this page. In Claude Code, ask: Allow Table Talk for {origin}

ChannelUrl.Name: Claude Code address (GM)
ChannelUrl.Hint: Where the Table Talk channel listens on the GM's computer. Only change this if you changed TABLE_TALK_PORT.

Engine.Name: Speech-to-text
Engine.Hint: Automatic uses your browser's built-in recognition and switches to a model that runs inside the browser (one-time download) when that isn't available, for example in Firefox or the Foundry desktop app.

Language.Name: Spoken language
Language.Hint: A language tag such as en-US or de-DE. Leave blank to use your browser's language.

SpokenSend.Name: "OK GM, send it"
SpokenSend.Hint: Let the GM send the queue by saying "OK GM, send it" while holding the talk key.

Talk.Name: Hold to talk
Talk.Hint: Hold while you speak; let go when you're done. Your words go to the GM's queue.

Send.Name: Send the queue (GM)
Send.Hint: Sends every waiting line to the Claude Code game master.
